title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature matters because it enables the framework to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, improving its usability and versatility. It will add a middleware function to parse request bodies and make the data available to route handlers. This will simplify the development process for users and make the framework more competitive
acceptance: Request body parsing works correctly for JSON and URL-encoded data, and errors are handled properly
reason: This feature is a key requirement for many web applications, and its implementation will significantly enhance the framework's functionality and appeal to developers
